name: Jehosheba (Joash's aunt)
title: The brave aunt who saved the royal heir
summary: Jehosheba was the daughter of King Joram of Judah and sister to King Ahaziah. She saved her nephew Joash from being killed by Queen Athaliah when she seized power, hiding him in the temple for six years. Her courageous act preserved David's royal line.

keyEvents.title: Saved Joash from Athaliah's massacre
keyEvents.description: When Athaliah saw that her son Ahaziah was dead, she decided to wipe out the entire royal family. Jehosheba took Joash, Ahaziah's son, and hid him along with his nurse in the bedroom.

keyEvents.title: Hid Joash in the temple
keyEvents.description: Jehosheba kept Joash hidden in the house of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled over the land. She was married to the high priest Jehoiada, which gave her access to the temple.

keyEvents.title: Preserved David's royal line
keyEvents.description: Through her courageous act, Jehosheba ensured that David's lineage continued on the throne of Judah, in accordance with God's promise to David of an eternal dynasty.
